snippets.text: fal says its H3 Max video model can now turn a Blender previs of up to 15 seconds into photoreal video, keeping camera movement and shot timing.
Elie Bakouch says DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and MiMo V3 both build their KV cache with YOCO, while Qwen 3.8 Next Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash interleave attention 3:1.
DigiTimes reports that TSMC plans to raise prices 3% to 6% in January 2027, with larger rises on advanced processes, according to Dan Nystedt.
Meta says Ray-Ban Display will show a photorealistic digital version of a caller's face on WhatsApp, driven by voice alone, in US early access this autumn.
Anthropic says health bodies including CEPI, WHO Africa and INRB Kinshasa are using Claude in their response to an unusual Ebola variant in the Congo.
Ollama says users can now buy usage credits for its paid cloud models without a subscription, and pay as they go.
Artificial Analysis says Claude Opus 5.5 at max effort in Claude Code scores 66 on its Coding Agent Index, the highest it has measured and 6 points above Opus 5.
Artificial Analysis puts inclusionAI's Ming-Image-0.1-Design, a 6B text-to-image model from Ant Group, first among open-weights models for UI/UX design and 17th overall in the category.
Mark Zuckerberg said Meta is building private processing for its glasses, so that when a wearer uses certain AI features nobody, including Meta, can reach their information.
TechCrunch says Meta's connector programme for its Muse agent drew more than 1,500 applications in under a week, with Stripe, Shopify, Walmart, Expedia, GitHub and Notion among the launch partners.
Simon Willison says he held a voice conversation with a Datasette backup of his blog through datasette-mcp, using the ChatGPT app on an iPhone.
The developer Theo says the root cause of the slow code highlighting in Claude turned out to be em dashes.
